AR.js 3.4.8 NFT build
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AR-js-org/AR.js/3.4.8/aframe/build/aframe-ar-nft.js
Licenses: ARJS-LICENSE.txt, ARTOOLKIT-LICENSE.txt, THREE-LICENSE.txt
Roll-by-Blow 0.3.26 adaptation: initialize from the source video dimensions
after metadata arrives, restart the worker when those dimensions change,
and retain the NFT projection matrix for the rendering camera.
Roll-by-Blow 0.3.27 adaptation: improve depth precision in the calibrated
projection and apply the pose filter in nft-pose.js.

MindAR.js 1.2.5 face build
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mind-ar@1.2.5/dist/mindar-face-aframe.prod.js
License: MINDAR-LICENSE.txt
Roll-by-Blow 0.3.27 adaptation: wait for the first video frame, report
startup errors, use a CPU fallback, and load the fixed MediaPipe
Tasks Vision 0.10.9 runtime from the same site.
The Face Landmarker model is loaded from the fixed upstream Google URL.
Roll-by-Blow 0.3.28 adaptation: initialize tracking while the front camera
opens, fetch model bytes concurrently with the runtime, reuse those bytes
for the CPU fallback, and skip unused blendshape scores.
Roll-by-Blow 0.3.29 adaptation: consume the model request started in
camera.js and report tracking initialization errors immediately.

MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.9 WebAssembly runtime
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.9/wasm/
License: mediapipe/MEDIAPIPE-LICENSE.txt
